title: 第1285章 葬仙关第1284章 北斗星域
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：剑问九州第1285章葬仙关（..la）“他想要什么，给他便是，必须让他尽快回归央土。”
“两界壁垒不会让他一个拥有天人境杀力的存在回归。”
“剑修到底是无赖，七境根基都不稳，竟然能有堪比八境的杀力。”
“不过是仰仗那把仙剑而已。想要坐稳八境杀力，一把稚嫩的仙剑，可还不够看。”
北斗，巨门星域。跌落至此的天渊三巨头你一言我一语，默默算计。
“既然如此，那就打到他跌境。总之绝不能让他坏了大计。”
“事到如今，还有意义吗？天渊炸碎，我们沦落至此，即便锚点打穿两界壁垒，可这里是远古战场，我们也没法降临央土。”
“只要世界树一动，就有机会。坐以待毙才是真的没机会。不成仙迟早也是个死！”
“那就让他跌境，只要弄不死就行。眼下就有合适的棋子。破军星域葬仙关那位递出的刀，拿来用用又何妨？”
“那就演一出好戏。”
……
另一边，白泽还未飞出北斗七座星域之一的廉贞星域，总有种莫名被注视的感觉。
那道人掐指一算，忍不住嘴角一抽。
好家伙，够阴的，竟然让他算出一条狗来。
还他娘的是一条穿着道袍的野狗，人模狗样。
白泽索性遏制住青舟，等了半日，那野狗道人终于忍不住了，从星空中现身。
白泽瞅他那副狗脸笑得跟菊花似的，把脸一板，问道：“你这老狗，尾随贫道至此，有何贵干？”
他已认出老狗身份，可对方既然愿意装，陪着便是。
野狗道人嘿嘿一笑，说道：“看道友这话说的。这廉贞星域甚是浩大，能与道友相遇在此，岂不是天定缘分？”
“我看未必。”白泽说道，“狗爷在何处得道？浪迹星域，莫不是被仇家追杀？”

“唉，道友此言差矣。”野狗道人说道，“搁廉贞星域，狗爷勉强也能上得了台面。只是这北斗浩瀚无边，横渡星域，没有星域域门可以走，着实难办。”
说着，野狗道人的贼溜溜的目光看向白泽的青舟。
“道友，你这飞行法器看起来颇为不俗。敢问道友是要往哪里去？如若顺路，可否带我一程？”
白泽微笑道：“你要往哪里去？”

"The Barrier of Two Realms will not allow him, a being with the killing power of the Heavenly Realm, to return."
"The sword cultivator is a scoundrel after all. The foundation of the Seventh Realm is not stable, but he can actually have killing power comparable to that of the Eighth Realm."
"It's just relying on that fairy sword. If you want to have the eight realms of killing power, a young fairy sword is not enough."
Beidou, Giant Gate Star Territory. The three giants of Tianyuan who have fallen here are talking to each other and silently calculating.
"In that case, then hit him until he falls. In short, we must not let him ruin the plan."
"Does it still make sense now? The abyss exploded, and we are reduced to this. Even if the anchor point breaks through the two barriers, this is an ancient battlefield, and we can't come to the central land."
"As long as the World Tree moves, there is a chance. There is really no chance if you sit still and wait for death. If you don't become an immortal, you will die sooner or later!"
"Then let him fall, as long as he doesn't die. There are suitable chess pieces right now. What's the harm in using the knife handed out by the person at Burial Immortal Pass in the Pojun Star Region?"
"Then put on a good show."
…
On the other side, Bai Ze has not yet flown out of the Lian Zhen Star Domain, one of the seven Star Domains of the Big Dipper, and he always feels like he is being watched inexplicably.
The Taoist counted his fingers and couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
Good guy, he was so sinister that he actually asked him to figure out a dog.
The one who returned the favor was a wild dog wearing a Taoist robe, looking like a human and a dog.
Bai Ze simply restrained Qing Zhou and waited for half a day before the wild dog Taoist finally couldn't bear it anymore and appeared from the starry sky.
Bai Ze looked at his dog face and smiled like a chrysanthemum. He straightened his face and asked, "You old dog, what are you doing following this poor man here?"
He has recognized the identity of the old dog, but since the other party is willing to pretend, he can just accompany him.
Taoist Wild Dog chuckled and said, "Look at what fellow Taoist said. This Lian Zhen Star Territory is very vast. Isn't it destiny to meet fellow Taoist here?"
"I don't think so." Bai Ze said, "Where did Mr. Dog achieve enlightenment? Wandering around the Star Territory, could he be hunted down by his enemies?"
"Alas, fellow Taoist, what you said is wrong." Taoist Wild Dog said, "Leave it to the Lianzhen Star Territory, Master Gou can barely get on the stage. It's just that the Beidou is vast and boundless, crossing the Star Territory, and there is no Star Territory Gate to go through, which is really difficult."
As he said this, Taoist Wild Dog looked at Bai Ze's Qing Zhou with his sneaky eyes.
"Fellow Taoist, your flying magic weapon looks quite good. May I ask where you are going, friend? If you are on the way, can you take me for a ride?"
Bai Ze smiled and said, "Where are you going?"
